case.narrative: My telematic control module has intermittent connectivity. The check engine light comes on and off and the go's, on star and wifi comes and goes as well.   This vehicle has 52k miles on it and is only 2 years old.  The shop I took this to said it is VIN specific so the dealer is the only place that can fix it.  This is a safety issue due to no onstar as onstar claims to be a safety feature.   This needs a recall because this issue is all over the place on gm products.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
